title: Dead End City — Brutini SVJ and motorcycle handling
introduction: The Brutini SVJ now uses a downloaded Aventador SVJ model. Motorcycle steering and wheelie lift return to the earlier handling, while W/S drive, the separate arrow-key rider controls, rider animations and wheelie distance achievements remain. These native game screenshots use matched inspection cameras at High quality, clear weather and 13:00. Exact source, capture and validation receipts are linked in the full audit.
